    value = 0
    if = { limit = { current_year >= 1359 } add = 0.25 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w6 } add = 0.25 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH } } add = 1.0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_rus_top_power = yes } add = 0.35 }
    if = { limit = { is_subject = no } add = 0.15 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rpl_reform_level ?= 2 } add = 0.15 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rpl_reform_level ?= 3 } add = 0.25 }
}
